places.quote: in the thronged thoroughfares of the metropolis
places.note: Generic reference to the city, identified as London.

places.quote: He passed along the streets as usual to Bleeding Heart Yard
places.note: Fictional yard in Clerkenwell; home of the Plornishes.

places.quote: on the settlement of that execution which had carried Mr Plornish to the Marshalsea College
places.note: Dickens's ironic name for the debtors' prison.

places.quote: Father was going over the water to pay his respects
places.note: Inferred from context; ambiguous phrase, likely crossing the Thames to Southwark.
